from datetime import datetime, timedelta

def count_valid_dates():
    target_year = 2023
    start_date = datetime(target_year, 1, 1)
    end_date = datetime(target_year, 12, 31)
    delta = timedelta(days=1)
    valid_count = 0

    for date in range(start_date, end_date + delta):

        mmdd = date.month
        dd = date.day
        mm = mmdd // 10
        dd_part = dd % 10
        mmdd_str = f"{mm:02d}{dd_part:02d}"
